package handlers

import (
	"context"
	"net/http"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	httpmw "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/transport/http/middleware"
	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
)

type StudentCourseAssignments interface {
	List(context.Context, string) ([]domain.StudentCourseAssignment, error)
	Get(context.Context, string, string) (domain.StudentCourseAssignment, error)
}

type StudentCourseAssignmentHandler struct {
	Courses StudentCourseAssignments
}

type studentCourseAssignmentResponse struct {
	CourseID         string                        `json:"course_id"`
	AssignmentStatus domain.CourseAssignmentStatus `json:"assignment_status"`
	AssignedAt       time.Time                     `json:"assigned_at"`
	StartedAt        *time.Time                    `json:"started_at,omitempty"`
	CompletedAt      *time.Time                    `json:"completed_at,omitempty"`
}

func (handler StudentCourseAssignmentHandler) List(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	studentID, _, ok := httpmw.UserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		http.Error(w, "unauthorized", http.StatusUnauthorized)
		return
	}
	if handler.Courses == nil {
		http.Error(w, "student Courses are not configured", http.StatusServiceUnavailable)
		return
	}
	items, err := handler.Courses.List(r.Context(), studentID)
	if err != nil {
		writeDomainError(w, err)
		return
	}
	response := make([]studentCourseAssignmentResponse, len(items))
	for index, item := range items {
		response[index] = publicStudentCourseAssignment(item)
	}
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{"items": response})
}

func (handler StudentCourseAssignmentHandler) Get(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	studentID, _, ok := httpmw.UserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		http.Error(w, "unauthorized", http.StatusUnauthorized)
		return
	}
	if handler.Courses == nil {
		http.Error(w, "student Courses are not configured", http.StatusServiceUnavailable)
		return
	}
	item, err := handler.Courses.Get(r.Context(), studentID, chi.URLParam(r, "courseID"))
	if err != nil {
		writeDomainError(w, err)
		return
	}
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, publicStudentCourseAssignment(item))
}

func publicStudentCourseAssignment(item domain.StudentCourseAssignment) studentCourseAssignmentResponse {
	return studentCourseAssignmentResponse{
		CourseID: item.CourseID, AssignmentStatus: item.Status, AssignedAt: item.AssignedAt,
		StartedAt: item.StartedAt, CompletedAt: item.CompletedAt,
	}
}
